pr_title: seat: Fix reloading cursor theme after change
pr_body:
This reverts commit afde6369
"seat: avoid unneeded reloading xcursor theme".
Always avoiding to reload the xcursor theme prevents reloading the
cursor even when this is desired. Instead seat_configure_xcursor
can determine whether a full reload is necessary.

To stay with the spirit of the reverted change, cursors are only fully
reloaded, if the theme has changed.

Fixes #6931
pr_comments: Thanks for fixing this, I ran into this while testing that functionality.

Sorry for the bump but is there anything holding this from being merged? I am also being negatively affected by #6931 and would like to see it resolved.

The failed job seems to be due to an unchanged and unrelated file (ipc-json.c).
@emersion Hello, do we miss something here for a review ? I've been on this branch for 1 month without realizing it, everything is ok from a functional point of view. Thanks!

issue_context.title: Changing mouse cursor theme using swaymsg has no effect
issue_context.body:
Sway version 1.7

I am trying to change the mouse cursor theme on a running instance of Sway. After some Googling, this seems to be the way to go:

```
$ swaymsg seat seat0 xcursor_theme Adwaita
```

However, this has no effect on a running instance of Sway. The mouse cursor theme on the desktop background and on window title bars remains the same.

However, if I put the lines in my Sway config:

```
seat seat0 xcursor_theme Adwaita
```

And reload my config using `$ swaymsg reload`, the cursor theme is set correctly.

Can the mouse cursor theme of Sway not be changed without restarting or reloading Sway's config?
comments: For anyone else still struggling with "mouse pointer shrinks when over a non-window (e.g. sway tab) on hidpi screens", explicitly setting the theme fixed that for me, and this issue made me realize I should try that.
